enochhome: a low antediluvian dwelling of packed mud and heavy timber standing alone on a dry upland, flat roof of laid reeds weighted with stones, one dark doorway, hard-swept bare ground outside, pale bare hills running back to a clear high horizon, everything lit by plain strong daylight
cainscity: a walled ancient city of dark fired brick on a flat dry plain, heavy square gate towers and tight streets of low flat roofs, smoke standing straight up above it, seen at distance across open ground under a hard bright sky
theedge: a boundless plain of smooth black glassy rock stretching flat to every horizon under an enormous pale empty sky, the ground polished enough to hold a dim reflection, a single bare unbroken expanse running to a bright distance, no vegetation and no structure anywhere on it
firewater: a broad river of molten fire pouring down a sheer black mountainside in deep darkness, thick and slow and heavy like running metal, throwing hard orange light up onto cliff walls of glassy rock, dense smoke standing in tall columns above it, embers riding the air
darkwater: a wide cold pale-grey river running steadily uphill into the open mouth of a deep black gorge, sheer wet rock walls leaning in overhead, one hard shaft of cold white light falling across the water where it enters
windpillars: colossal vertical columns of visible moving air standing in a row at the edge of the world, each one enormous and solid-looking with hard defined edges, dust and grit spiralling densely inside them, a flat bare stone plain beneath and a bright hard sky above
cornerstone: the exposed corner of the earth itself, one titanic square-cut foundation block of pale weathered stone with flat tooled faces and sharp right-angled edges, laid level and projecting out over an immeasurable drop, the surrounding land bedded against two of its faces, the geometry unmistakably built rather than eroded
sevenmountains: seven colossal mountains of coloured precious stone standing together on a bare dark plain, each one enormous and smooth-flanked with hard clean edges, the stone deeply coloured and translucent at the ridges, one hard shaft of pale light crossing the group
thronepeak: the seventh mountain at the centre of the group, its entire summit carved into the colossal shape of a great seat hundreds of feet high, arms and a high back and a broad step formed out of the white stone of the mountain itself, heavy dark trees ringing the base far below, one narrow shaft of bright cold light standing on the summit
starprison: a vast open pit sunk into bare rock with no floor visible in it, seven enormous burning stars held fixed in the air within the shaft, each one massive and material and solid with full weight, ringed in hard white fire, the pale rock rim scorched and cracked around the edge
westmountain: an immense mountain of hard grey-black rock standing alone in the west, sheer-sided and unbroken, its whole face sheared flat as if cut, four great arched openings cut into the base in a row, the surrounding ground bare swept stone under a low hard light
westmountain_after: the same immense grey-black mountain in the west standing in still grey water up to the base of its arches, the sheared face wet and dark to a clear waterline, the bare stone ground around it gone under flat colourless water
hollowone: a deep hollow chamber cut into grey rock, wide and clean with very smooth walls, lit warm and even from within by a bright spring of clear water running out over pale stone, the light steady and golden, the far wall fully visible
hollowtwo: a deep hollow chamber of very smooth dark rock, wide and running back into clear deep dark, one hard shaft of cold pale light entering at the mouth and reaching only the near floor
hollowthree: a deep hollow chamber of smooth grey rock crowded with standing human figures all facing one direction, the figures solid and opaque and ordinary with full weight and hard shadow at their feet, cold even light from the mouth of the chamber
hollowfour: an arched opening cut into grey rock and filled floor to ceiling with one unbroken slab of the same stone, flush and seamless with a visible seam line where the slab meets the arch, one hard line of shadow across its face, the surrounding wall bare and dry
floodwater: still grey water standing level over a drowned plain out to the horizon, the tops of dark brick towers breaking the flat surface, a low colourless sky above, the water perfectly calm and opaque
tablet: a flat rectangular writing tablet of pale stone about the size of two hands, the surface smooth and bare with only a few short incised lines at one edge, the edges worn round and catching the light
enochman: a lean upright man of middle years in a heavy undyed woollen robe, dark beard cut short, weathered sunlit face, bare unadorned hands and forearms, moving with purpose
guideone: an enormous living man standing about twice the height of an ordinary person beside him, robed from shoulder to ankle in heavy undyed pale grey wool, calm weathered human face, broad and physically solid with full weight and a hard cast shadow
guidetwo: an enormous living man standing about twice the height of an ordinary person beside him, robed from shoulder to ankle in heavy deep red-brown wool, weathered human face and dark hair, broad and physically solid with full weight and a hard cast shadow, both hands open and empty at rest
tabletfull: a flat rectangular writing tablet of pale stone about the size of two hands, its whole face cut edge to edge with dense straight lines of small incised script, the grooves holding shadow, the edges worn round
upland: a dry bare upland of pale packed earth and low scattered scrub running to open horizons, shallow dry watercourses cutting through low hills, the ground hard-swept and stony, wild trackless country far from any settlement, a wide clear sky above
fireplain: a vast dark plain of bare fractured rock under a low unlit sky, running flat to distant black mountains, the ground dry and swept and littered with loose stone
burningmen: a figure of standing flame at about the height of a man, fire all the way through and holding a clear upright human shape, solid and opaque with real mass, throwing hard orange light onto everything near it
steamshore: a dark rock coastline meeting a flat cold sea under a low sky, black wet stones along the waterline, an enormous white wall of steam standing off the water and glowing orange from below
windstores: an enormous row of open doorways of cut pale stone set into a cliff at the edge of the world, each giving onto a vast vaulted chamber, dense visible currents of moving air held inside them, the whole scene in warm amber and cold grey tones under hard raking daylight, photorealistic and physically solid, bare swept ground before them
wasteplace: a boundless open dark beyond the last edge of solid rock, the rim of pale stone ending in one clean cut line, deep clear darkness falling away below it and standing open above it, hard cold light reaching only the final ground
angelprison: a colossal cleft torn down through dark rock running beyond the reach of sight, its walls sheer and vertical, enormous straight-sided columns of fire descending steadily into it, the rock lit hard orange along their whole path
archface: an enormous plane of grey-black rock rising sheer from bare ground, the whole side of a mountain taken down flat with fine parallel working marks across it, four colossal arched openings cut in a row into its base, cold hard light raking the surface, a single continuous photographic frame
